en.headline: LANY plays AsiaWorld-Expo on Wednesday in Soft World Tour
en.dek: The Los Angeles duo's standing-only show at Hall 10 starts at 8pm, with general tickets from HK$699 according to promoter Live Nation.
body: Los Angeles alternative-pop duo LANY is due to play AsiaWorld-Expo Hall 10 on Wednesday night as part of the Soft World Tour, promoter Live Nation said.

The concert is scheduled for 8pm on 30 September. The promoter listed the show as all-standing, with general tickets from HK$699 and VIP packages from HK$1,569. Standing areas are limited to people aged 12 or above who are at least 140 centimetres tall.

Live Nation is offering two VIP packages. The Last Forever Fan Experience includes early entry, a pre-show soundcheck, a question-and-answer session with band members Paul Klein and Jake Goss, a group photograph and signed merchandise. A second Soft VIP package includes later-tier early entry, a laminate and merchandise. The promoter said not every question may be answered and that on-site merchandise depends on availability.

General tickets went on sale in late March. AsiaWorld-Expo is on Lantau beside Hong Kong International Airport and is served by the Airport Express and buses. The date falls on the eve of the National Day holiday.

zh.headline: LANY周三亞博館舉行Soft World巡演香港站
zh.dek: 洛杉磯二人組合周三晚8時於亞洲國際博覽館10號展館演出，主辦稱全場企位，一般門票由699元起。
body: 主辦Live Nation表示，洛杉磯另類流行組合LANY將於周三晚在亞洲國際博覽館10號展館舉行Soft World巡演香港站。
演出定於9月30日晚上8時，全場企位。主辦列出一般門票由699元起，VIP套票由1,569元起。企位區域只供12歲或以上、身高不少於140厘米人士進入。
Live Nation設兩款VIP套票。The Last Forever Fan Experience包括優先入場、演前soundcheck、與成員Paul Klein及Jake Goss的問答環節、十人一組合照及簽名周邊；Soft VIP則包括較後批次優先入場、紀念掛繩及禮品。主辦指提問未必全部獲回應，現場周邊視乎供應。
公開售票已於3月底開始。亞博館位於大嶼山香港國際機場旁，可乘機場快絶及巴士前往。演出正值國慶假期前夕。
